# WAVE name starts a wave. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# SKILIFT x y targetX health speed
# SPREADSHOT x y targetX targetY health speed
# Coordinates are fractions of the playfield width/height (0 to 1).
# A coordinate may be min..max, sampled independently on every spawn.
# Equal bounds are fixed; otherwise the minimum is inclusive and maximum exclusive.
# Speeds are pixels per second. Enemies patrol and attack as usual.
# Waves play in order; the final wave repeats for endless play.
